September 26, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-26-1971-54699

Governor Malik starts an anti-radio show in Radio Pakistan. He urges the students not to get involved into any sort of anti-state activities.

A Jamaat team visits London. Jamaat leader Maolana Khalil says: “No power can divide Pakistan.” Another leader Maolana Hamidi says: “There is nothing called a so called state named Bangladesh.”
